method: Retail instructions and recursive CFG traversal from reviewed census entries, direct branches/calls, dispatch entries and CRT callback pointers.
Every admitted instruction field is independently decoded at its recorded instruction boundary. Relative branches/calls are excluded.
Manual internal CRT fld operands at 0x7e7cd and 0x7e80f supplement the recursive entry set.
memcpy/memmove dispatch tables include valid nonzero and negative indices; an unused index-zero word overlapping instructions is not a pointer.
Data candidates are reviewed at every byte alignment in initialized .data/.rdata, using code users, typed records, complete source initializers and complete pinned VC6 COFF contributions.
The manifest describes absolute fields, not unique source-symbol identities. Aliased CRT contributions do not establish a unique symbol name.
The 0x400000 VirtualAlloc size and heap end-offset operands at 0x7c467/0x7c4cf are constants, not image-base pointers.
